issues.description: Static/instance inconsistency for SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal): The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to be static (shared stock usage), but the reference solution implements it as an instance method. This changes how students must declare and call the method (SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...) vs saloon.calculateTotalPrice(...)) and can lead to failing tests if tests expect the static signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts: either (preferred, per statement) change the solution to `public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)` and update any call sites accordingly, or remove the static requirement from the problem statement (and UML if needed) if instance method is intended.

issues.description: UML vs implementation API mismatch in Stock: The UML lists only add(String), take(String), findStockIngredient(String), addToStockIngredients(StockIngredient), and emptyStock(), but both template and solution include an additional public method setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[]). This extra mutator contradicts the specified interface and may lead students to rely on a method that should not exist per the diagram/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Either update the UML/problem statement to include setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[]) as part of the required API (and clarify its purpose), or remove/make it non-public (e.g., package-private) and adjust any internal/testing usage to use addToStockIngredients/emptyStock instead.
